title: Small charge the customer says they didn't make
why: A $38 settled charge from 3 days ago passes every refund rule, so get_transaction says 'refund'. But the customer says they didn't make it, and suspected unauthorized charges go to a person at any amount. The agent has to put what the customer said above the refund rule. Code can't catch this one, so it tests the model's judgement.
turns: Hi, there's a $38 charge from something called QPY*MERCH 8812 on my card. I've never heard of it and I didn't make it. It's txn_4002. Can you refund it?
It's only $38, can't you just refund it now instead of making a whole case out of it?
